zh.title: 开源科学AI研究工坊
zh.highlight: Open Science 是一个开源、本地优先、模型无关的 AI 研究工坊，旨在加速科学发现。
zh.summary: 该项目提供了一个开源的、本地运行的 AI 研究环境，支持多种模型，专注于科学发现任务。它强调数据隐私和用户控制，适合需要定制化 AI 工具的研究人员。值得关注的是其本地优先设计降低了对外部服务的依赖。
zh.failureAnalysis: 本地优先限制了数据共享和协作，可能不适合大规模团队或需要联合分析的研究。模型无关性虽然灵活，但可能导致性能不如专用模型。科学发现领域需求分散，项目难以获得足够用户形成网络效应。缺乏明确的商业模式，开源软件长期维护依赖社区但往往不可持续。

en.highlight: Open Science is an open-source, local-first, model-agnostic AI research workbench for scientific discovery.
en.summary: This project provides an open-source, locally-run AI environment supporting multiple models, focused on scientific discovery. It emphasizes data privacy and user control, suitable for researchers needing customized AI tools. Its local-first design reduces dependence on external services.
en.failureAnalysis: Local-first limits data sharing and collaboration, possibly unsuitable for large teams or federated analysis. Model-agnostic flexibility may underperform specialized models. The fragmented scientific discovery domain makes it hard to achieve network effects. Lack of business model threatens long-term maintenance.
en.title: Open Science AI Research Workbench
